architecture.mechanism: Continuous capture of voltage, current, and temperature operating parameters, combined with local feature extraction and temporal sequence analysis, predicts wiring-harness degradation level before functional failure.
architecture.intervention: Instrument the ECM wiring-harness connector and feed voltage, current, and temperature time-series into a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention prognostic model that flags intermittent/loose connection degradation and alerts maintenance before transmission shift behavior is affected.
architecture.expected_effect: Early detection of the loose ECM wire connection during normal driving, so the harness is secured before gear-selection or manual-option faults appear, preserving steering and transmission control without warning lights.
architecture.falsification_test: Run accelerated aging and vibration-loosening trials on ECM harness connectors; if the model cannot predict the degradation level (or detect the loose-connection signature) from voltage/current/temperature traces before measurable shift anomalies occur, the mechanism is falsified.
